thread:
mara: Heads up — a EU customer reported a DSAR deletion that shows as completed in the API but the archived snapshot still exists in backups. Suspect this started after last night's KMS rotation.
jonathan: copying logs now. i see a bunch of decrypt errors from snapshot-worker right after the rotate.
jonathan: ```\nERROR 2025-06-03T02:07:12Z service=snapshot-worker err=decrypt_failed code=PermissionDenied details=serviceAccount:snapshot@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com lacks roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter\n```
anya: if the snapshot worker can't decrypt manifests, the delete job marks them incomplete and leaves the snapshot object. that matches.
kevin: did we change any service account IAM during the rotation? rotation script should not alter IAM bindings.
mara: rotation runbook used: internal/runbooks/kms-rotate. i see a post-rotate step that calls iam:removeBinding for the old key owner — maybe the target principal name changed and the binding removal matched the snapshot SA accidentally.
jonathan: timeline: rotate at 02:00Z, errors spike 02:05-02:12Z, delete jobs retried at 03:00Z and left failures. incident-bot: created incident-7892 (severity: medium) for DSAR propagation failures.
anya: immediate remediation: re-grant decrypt to snapshot service account on the new key: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding KEY --member=serviceAccount:snapshot@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
kevin: i'll run that and then kick the manual backfill: `tools/dsar/backfill-erase --tenant eu --since 2025-06-01`
kevin: done — IAM binding added, backfill queued (job id bf-451). seeing progress in queue.
audit-bot: audit log: RESOURCE=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/key1 ACTION=SetIamPolicy PRINCIPAL=ops@redwood.com
mara: long-term action items: (1) add a unit/regression CI that simulates KMS rotate and validates DSAR delete propagation end-to-end, (2) prevent runbook IAM removals from matching service accounts by mistake (narrower principals), (3) add an alert for "dsar-snapshot decrypt errors" with faster page.
anya: also need legal check: a subset of affected requests had a retention-exception flag. we must ensure we don't backfill deletes for those until legal confirms. i've flagged bf-451 to skip any requests with retention_exception=true.
jonathan: note for RM: update RBAC policy so snapshot SA uses a dedicated principal never touched by key owner purge actions. document in infra/iam/README.
kevin: can we add a short audit query to find other recent rotations that ran the old runbook step? `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"SetIamPolicy\" AND resource.labels.keyRing=keystore" --freshness=7d`
mara: good idea — jonathan, can you run that and paste results here. any matches => we'll open follow-up tickets.
jonathan: running now, returning two matches where the binding removal targeted a wildcard principal. filing eng-infra ticket INFRA-2243.
mara: thanks. closing incident once backfill finishes and legal confirms retention exceptions. will follow up with a short retro and runbook patch.
anya: also propose TTL-based minimization for ephemeral embeddings so DSAR surface shrinks overall — i'll draft a proposal.
kevin: adding automated post-rotate smoke test to rotate pipeline: decrypt sample snapshot + run db-mark-delete check.
mara: appreciate the quick triage. tag me if anything surfaces or if legal asks for the evidence bundle. :thumbsup:
